blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Forensic financial analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera told the Senate Impeachment Court on Monday that Vice President Sara Duterte’s underdeclaration in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN) and questionable business financial statements indicated deliberate concealment of wealth. Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros asked Cabrera if there were signs of deliberate concealment of wealth after he reported that Duterte and her spouse, lawyer Manases Carpio, supposedly had unexplained wealth worth P817 million. “I will just use the percentage of underdeclaration or underreporting [in the SALN] because that is what makes it manifestly disproportionate [to their lawful income],” Cabrera said.
